flipToBack.prose: Collect your senators AT Galactic Senate (Filters.filterActive with SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE). Flip if that collection has >= 3 senators, OR >= 2 senators with at least one of them having a blockade agenda.

children.req: count of your senators at location: >= 3 cards in Filters.filterActive(...) collection
count of your senators at location: >= 2
agenda-state within that senator collection: at least one has a blockade agenda

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if you have FEWER than 2 senators at Galactic Senate (cannot spot 2 of your senators at Galactic Senate; spot includes battle-excluded).

children.req: count-spot: at least 2 of your senators at Galactic Senate

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: 'with <actor> there' presence-count semantics: Filters.at(Filters.Galactic_Senate) presence of YOUR cards matching Filters.senator; NOT control or occupy of the location. Opponent presence at the Senate is irrelevant to the flip.
Alternative branch: same presence-count at 2 plus an agenda-state check (Filters.blockade_agenda spotted among those senators).
flipToFront: negated count-spot: fewer than 2 your senators at Galactic Senate. Maintaining 2+ senators there holds the back.

NOTE: engine filter is Filters.senator; project memory says only 29 of 35 senator cards carry Keyword.SENATOR (others say 'senator' only in lore). Whether Filters.senator covers lore-only senators is an engine-filter question that matters for AI planning against this law.
typedIdentities: Filters.stackedOn(self, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.Political_Effect)) (may deploy as if from hand)

missingStateCalculation: ObjectiveAnalyzer evaluates the front in exact CNF: every route needs two senators at Galactic Senate, then either a third senator or a blockade-agenda senator among that location-scoped actor set.

Two agenda-less senators satisfy only the floor. Three senators satisfy both rules. Two senators with the exact blockade agenda satisfy both rules. A peace agenda does not complete the Dark alternative.
On the back, the analyzer arms flip-back risk only when the owner count at Galactic Senate is one or zero. Two senators are stable.
flipPreservation: V108 makes a senator deploy beat a generic character and Pass; V88 makes Galactic Senate beat the other Episode I setup site.
An exact pre-flip senator-to-Senate deployment releases only Formation Safety's ordinary unsupported-solo defer. The contested weak-solo hard block remains dominant.

Before flip, a counted senator is held while its removal would leave neither the three-senator route nor the two-plus-blockade route complete. Redundant senators release when another exact route survives.
After flip, either of the last two senators is protected against movement, standalone Force loss, and battle forfeit while another legal expendable card exists. A third senator is redundant.
runtimeOwners: ObjectiveAnalyzer owns Senate-family identity, typed profile hydration, exact CNF state, counted onTable removal arithmetic, and pre-flip/post-flip formation roles.
The existing V83/V88/V108/V110 deploy adjustments own senator priority, Galactic Senate destination priority, off-site penalties, and non-senator holds without new magnitudes.
Mirrored CardSelectionEvaluator adapters release only the exact unsupported-solo defer and preserve Formation Safety's hard danger result.
MoveObjectiveGateHoldPolicy, ForceLossPolicy V109, and BattleForfeitPolicy consume the shared counted formation roles. Rando and Chosen One use identical owners and winners.
contradictions: Control or occupation of Galactic Senate is not required. The law counts the owner's senators at that location.
The agenda shortcut is blockade for this Dark printing. Peace agenda is the Light sibling's route and must remain neutral here.
Exactly three agenda-less senators are not redundant before the flip: removing one leaves two agenda-less senators and breaks the front condition. A fourth plain senator is redundant.
The structured actor-count rules, not null legacy flipGateSite or empty flipGateCardIds fields, own the exact gate.
Batch Eleven's native flip test did not prove live removal protection. Commit 4942781ab repairs the previously inert relation:onTable and stayFlipped consumers.
